summary_en: FY3/26 full-year dividend raised to 50 yen/share (40 ordinary + 10 commemorative) from 40 yen guidance. Interim dividend increased to 34 yen/share (24 ordinary + 10 commemorative) from 24 yen. Special 10-yen commemorative dividend at period-end marks market upgrade from TSE Growth to TSE Prime. FY3/27 EPS target 140 yen; payout ratio target ≥40%.
title_en: Notice of Revision of Dividend Forecast (Increase)
translation_en_brief: TASUKI Holdings raised its FY3/26 (ending September 30, 2026) dividend forecast on June 15, 2026. Full-year dividend per share increases from 40 yen to 50 yen, comprising 40 yen ordinary dividend and 10 yen commemorative dividend. Interim dividend per share increases from 24 yen to 34 yen, comprising 24 yen ordinary dividend and 10 yen commemorative dividend. The 10-yen commemorative dividend at period-end marks the company's market-segment upgrade from TSE Growth to TSE Prime, announced the same day. The company cited investor support and elevated market expectations following the promotion as justification for enhanced capital allocation. The company targets a FY3/27 EPS of 140 yen and maintains a progressive dividend policy with a payout ratio target of at least 40%, balancing growth investment and financial soundness.
